🚀 crosspaste-desktop | Kotlin
🎯 Primary Use Case: Seamlessly synchronize clipboard content across multiple devices on a local network, ensuring privacy and security.
✨ Key Features: • Real-time Sharing • Cross-platform (macOS, Windows, Linux) • Rich Type Support (Text, Color, URL, HTML, RTF, Image, File) • End-to-End Encryption • LAN-only Serverless Architecture
📖 Summary: CrossPaste Desktop is a cross-platform application for synchronizing clipboard content between macOS, Windows, and Linux devices. It prioritizes privacy with end-to-end encryption and a serverless, LAN-only architecture, also featuring OCR and CLI capabilities.
